title: Titanium Slip-On Flange
function: Slip-on flange for low-pressure chemical ducting
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this pipe fitting application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by slip-on flange for low-pressure chemical ducting and fat life requirements.
process: Hot forming plate rolling for pipe fitting geometry
CNC corrosion allowance with SPC sampling
TIG welding Grade 2 with SPC sampling
Hydrostatic shell test with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming — tailored for slipon flange for application
commonFailures: Pitting in stagnant HCl above 60C - requires Grade 12 for Mo-enhanced passive film stability — critical for slipon flange for performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Slip-On Flange suitable for Slip-on flange for low-pressure chemical ducting?
faq.a: Titanium Slip-On Flange uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address pipe fitting operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Slip-On Flange?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Slip-On Flange is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for slipon flange for requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Slip-On Flange require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. slipon flange for components require Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming — tailored for slipon flange for application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Slip-On Flange shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Slip-On Flange includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet slipon flange for specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
